# Schematika

> Python library for programmatic IEC 60617 electrical schematic generation

## Docs

- [LLM Reference](docs/LLM_REFERENCE.md): Complete API cheat sheet for LLM circuit generation
- [Pin Configuration](docs/guides/PIN_CONFIGURATION.md): IEC pin standards and customization
- [Naming Convention](docs/NAMING_CONVENTION.md): Tag and component naming standards

## Examples

- [01 Single Relay](examples/01_single_relay.py): Minimal circuit (6 lines)
- [02 DOL Starter](examples/02_dol_starter.py): Standard 3-phase motor control
- [03 Control Circuit](examples/03_control_circuit.py): Tag reuse across circuits
- [04 PSU Circuit](examples/04_psu_circuit.py): Power supply with dynamic block
- [05 Full Cabinet](examples/05_full_cabinet.py): Multi-page PDF project

## API

- [CircuitBuilder](src/schematika/electrical/builder.py): Core builder API
- [Symbol Factories](src/schematika/electrical/symbols/__init__.py): All available electrical symbols
- [Project](src/schematika/project.py): Multi-page PDF compilation
